guardrails: Remote device communication is read-only until an explicit authenticated write channel is implemented.
Do not expose the server to the public internet without firewall, authentication, and reverse-proxy review.
Use --host 0.0.0.0 only on a trusted LAN when Zephyr or Honor X5c need access.
Do not store device passwords, Wi-Fi credentials, browser cookies, or tokens in this repository.
Treat Zephyr and Honor X5c as configured but unverified until a live client check from each device is recorded.
next_verification: Start Aria PC server with --host 0.0.0.0 on trusted LAN when remote clients need access.
Find the Aria PC LAN IP with ipconfig and open http://<aria-pc-lan-ip>:8787/api/health from Zephyr.
Open http://<aria-pc-lan-ip>:8787/api/health from Honor X5c on the same Wi-Fi.
Record successful client checks in a future receipt before marking remote clients verified.
